name: fresh-answer-modes
description: Current, sourced answers in full, concise, and read-only modes.

interface.longDescription: Fresh Answer Modes guides ChatGPT and Codex to check current evidence before answering. Choose a full answer, a concise answer, or a concise read-only answer. Each mode cites direct sources for material claims and states when current information cannot be verified. Live-source availability depends on the tools available in each chat. Read-only mode inspects information without changing files or external records.
defaultPrompt: What changed in the latest Python release? Cite official sources.
Briefly summarize the latest Artemis update with direct sources.
Check the current facts about a topic, answer briefly, and make no changes.
